# North Hollywood Auto Body

North Hollywood Auto Body is a family-owned collision and auto body shop in North Hollywood, California.
We are at 4872 Lankershim Boulevard, North Hollywood, CA 91601, between Huston Street and La Maida Street.
We do collision repair, auto body repair, auto painting, towing and rental help, and insurance claim help.
We have served North Hollywood for over 25 years.
Every repair carries a lifetime warranty.
Estimates are free by appointment.
Hours are Monday through Friday, 8am to 5pm. Closed Saturday and Sunday.
Call (818) 980-8668 or email nohoautobody@yahoo.com.
We serve North Hollywood and the San Fernando Valley.
Website: https://www.northhollywoodautobody.com/
